title: Putting money in: lump sum, SIP, STP, SWP, switch, redemption
objectives: Explain SIP, STP and SWP by which way the money flows.
Say what a switch and a redemption are, and how long redemption usually takes.
body_md:
A lump sum invests a single larger amount at once. A SIP (Systematic Investment Plan) invests a fixed amount automatically at regular intervals from the bank — for example ₹10,000 on the 5th of every month. A step-up SIP rises each year with income. An STP moves money in instalments from one fund to another, usually debt to equity. An SWP takes out a fixed amount regularly. A switch moves money between schemes of the same AMC and counts as a sale and a purchase; redemption is selling units to get money back, usually in 1–3 business days for equity funds.

| Term | Plain meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lump sum | Investing a single, larger amount at once | ₹5 lakh bonus invested on one day |
| SIP (Systematic Investment Plan) | A fixed amount invested automatically at regular intervals | ₹10,000 on the 5th of every month |
| Step-up SIP | SIP amount rises each year, usually with income | ₹10,000 rising 10% a year |
| STP (Systematic Transfer Plan) | Moving money in instalments from one fund to another, usually debt to equity | ₹12 lakh in a liquid fund, ₹1 lakh a month moved to equity |
| SWP (Systematic Withdrawal Plan) | Taking out a fixed amount regularly from a fund | Retiree withdraws ₹40,000 a month |
| Switch | Moving money from one scheme to another in the same AMC; treated as a sale and a purchase | Switching from regular to direct plan |
| Redemption | Selling units to get money back | Money usually reaches the bank in 1–3 business days for equity funds |

> **Talk-track:** “Before we invest, three checks: is your KYC and nomination done, which plan and option are you choosing, and what will it cost you in rupees?”
example: ₹12 lakh parked in a liquid fund, ₹1 lakh a month moved to equity by STP; a retiree takes ₹40,000 a month by SWP.
say: SIP moves money from your bank; STP moves money from one fund to another.
An SWP amount is chosen by you; the date is fixed by you.
never: STP and SIP are the same thing.
A switch is free of tax because it stays in one AMC.
